name: W Hotel, POV Terrace
lede: At the W Hotel’s POV Terrace Bar in Washington, D.C., new Tungsten and Platinum Electric heaters drew questions from the tables about how they work and how good they look.
data: Tungsten Smart-Heat® Electric · Platinum Smart-Heat® Electric

hero.caption: The terrace at night, a heater on the canopy edge. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: The POV Terrace Bar sits on top of the W Hotel in Washington, D.C., with tables under a canopy and the city beyond.
The case study does not set out the brief: the bar wanted heaters that worked for the size of the space and looked right.
Tungsten Smart-Heat Electric and Platinum Smart-Heat Electric heaters were installed at the terrace bar. The case study gives no quantities or positions.

quote.text: We remember having a lot of tables ask and inquire about how efficient and cool they looked.
